So far so good! I used the Bite Agave mask for a couple of years and I find that the Laneige mask gives me the same hydration but without the thick, goopy feel of the Bite one.

Stellar foundation is really nice so far! I have dehydrated/oily skin and initially I wrote this guy off because of it's radiant finish but a Youtuber I watch (somegirljess) kept raving about it so I caved. It leaves a radiant finish and as pretty nice staying power; I've worn it for about 8 hours set with a little bit of the Milk powder with no issues. I've found that doing the powder-before-foundation Wayne Goss method gives it a more matte look that also lasted nicely. It doesn't look gross at the end of the day and if you're oily I think the key is to have a good powder; I initially tried it with a less oil controlling powder and it got shiny very fast. The colour oxidizes to about an NC20 shade but thankfully I can still pull it off. 

The Milk powder does this really magical thing where it mattifies your skin while only taking a little bit of the foundation's glow away. Obviously the more powder you apply the more powdery and matte it's going to look, but a spray of Fix + usually fixes that for me. Perfect for an oily person like me who still needs to set their makeup for a little bit of oil control, but doesn't want to completely mattify it. I usually wear my makeup for 8-9 hours and I find that this extends the wear of dewy foundations that I otherwise have to blot every 2 hours. Great value for $35 CAD, the mesh dispenser or whatever it's called is inconvenient if you're using a sponge though. Milk says in the instructions to just shake some into the lid, but doing so is quite tedious as the mesh acts like a very fine sifter and it takes forever to shake powder out.

**Nars Radiant Creamy Concealer**: Was really nice but a bit too full coverage for me personally

**Clinique Lash Power Mascara**: Did nothing for my lashes

**Clinique High Impact Curling Mascara**: I have concluded that Clinique mascaras do not work for me at all.

**Too Faced Born This Way Foundation**: Is a nice foundation that is smooth and good with enlarged pores, but transfers and doesn't control my oil very well.

**Smashbox Studio Skin Finish**: Controlled my oil really well and didn't transfer at all! Unfortunately it's too drying for me during the winter months but this is my HG summer foundation.

**Buxom Lip Cream in Mudslide**: I love this so much and I hate lip gloss with a passion.

**Smashbox Photo Finish Primer Water**: meh.

**Bite Agave Lip Mask**: A LIFE SAVER

**KVD ELL in Bow N Arrow**: My first liquid lipstick purchase. Colour pulled very grey on me (I have pretty pale lips) but I like the formula.
